yīnwèi… suǒyǐ… — because… so…: suīrán… dànshì… — although… (still)…
wèi shénme — why
bǐ — compared to (我比他高 = I'm taller than him)
cóng — from (从北京来 = come from Beijing)
lí — (distance) from (我家离公司很远 = my home is far from the office)
wǎng — toward (往前走 = go straight ahead)
gěi — to give; for (someone)
duì — correct; to/towards (对我很好 = good to me)
guo — (after a verb) have done before (我去过中国 = I've been to China)
zhe — (after a verb) ongoing state (门开着 = the door is open)
de — (after a verb) how well something is done (说得很好 = speaks very well)
ba — (end particle) let's…; I suppose… (我们走吧 = let's go)
yào — to want; to need to; going to
cì — time(s), occurrences (三次 = three times)
jiàn — measure word for clothes and matters (一件衣服)
dì yī — first
liǎng — two (before a measure word: 两个人)
líng — zero
bǎi — hundred
qiān — thousand
hào — day of the month; number (五月三号 = May 3rd)
tā — it
nín — you (polite)
yíxià — (after a verb) briefly; give it a go (看一下 = take a look)
wán — to finish; done (吃完了 = finished eating)
